title: listensmith now-playing submission (playing_now)
$comment: ListenBrainz's playing_now shape as pinned in common.schema.json, which forbids listened_at, plus the player state. A display computes the live position as ls_position_seconds plus (now minus ls_measured_at) times ls_rate. Sent on every change and on the heartbeat while playing; the relay marks the feed stale after the silence window. Both timings are in defaults.json.

ls_position_seconds.description: Seconds into the track when ls_measured_at was read, up to the track duration's 24-day ceiling.

ls_rate.description: Playback speed, for podcasts and audiobooks at other speeds; 1.0 when absent. At most 16.

ls_measured_at.description: The Unix time, in seconds, at which ls_position_seconds was read, up to the last second of 9999-12-31 UTC.
